2018: WELCOME TO THE 2018 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, four teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · RED — A perfect circle of chaos. Brick Cock buried Double Deuce 22-6. Double Deuce ran past Flangers 21-7. Then Flangers stunned Brick Cock 14-13. Three teams locked at 2-1 and only the points column to split them. DOUBLE DEUCE, BRICK COCK and FLANGERS advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — White Zin was untouchable: 3-0 and 65 points, the biggest number anybody posted all day. Behind them, three teams deadlocked at 1-2 — and John-John's 18-17 thriller over Steam Punks came one point too late. WHITE ZIN, THE BRYAN ADAMS SHOW and STEAM PUNKS advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Don Cuzzi and On Wisconsin went the whole way without losing. Both 2-0-1. Deadlocked. Separated by one solitary point, 50 to 49. DON CUZZI, ON WISCONSIN and JOANIE LOVES BOCCE advance.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — The Hawkeyes swept it 3-0 and never looked troubled. And spare a thought for Mustache Riders: 49 points, MORE than TNT's 47, but a 1-2 record dropped them to the nine line. HAWKEYES, TNT and MUSTACHE RIDERS advance.

ROUND ONE — Mustache Riders sent Flangers home. On Wisconsin handled group-mate Joanie Loves Bocce for the second time in a day. TNT ended the Bryan Adams Show. And Brick Cock closed the book on the Steam Punks. Four in, four out, and the bracket was set.

QUARTERFINALS — White Zin rolled on. The Hawkeyes turned back TNT, the group rival they'd already beaten once. But the noise came from the bottom half: Brick Cock, the SIX seed, took down unbeaten Don Cuzzi — and On Wisconsin ousted Double Deuce. Both top-four seeds, gone.

SEMIFINALS — White Zin ended On Wisconsin's unbeaten day to punch the first ticket. On the other side the Hawkeyes stopped the Brick Cock giant-killers cold. Two group winners left standing. Neither one of them had lost a game all tournament.

THE FINAL — White Zin: the one seed, 3-0 in the group, a tournament-best 65 points, five straight wins, not a blemish on them. The Hawkeyes: 3-0 themselves, the two seed, three straight in the bracket including a revenge game over TNT. Something had to give.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: THE HAWKEYES 🏆 — They swept their group, beat back a group rival who wanted them badly, buried the bracket's biggest giant-killer, and then took down the number one seed with the trophy sitting on the table. Perfect from the first hole to the last. 2018 belongs to the Hawkeyes.
2019: WELCOME TO THE 2019 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, six teams per group (five in Blue). Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — Carnage at the top: John-John took it at 4-1, and behind them THREE teams finished 3-2. Hawkeyes had 79 points, Loopers 77, Trash Panda's 84 — and it was Trash Panda's points and a head-to-head loss that pushed the Hawkeyes out. Wildcat never found it, 0-5. JOHN-JOHN, TRASH PANDA'S and LOOPERS advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Kase-Kare-Cock went 4-1 and took the group. Joanie Loves Bocce and White Zin both came home 3-1-1, unbeaten but for one apiece, and Joanie's 84 points to White Zin's 79 decided the order. KASE-KARE-COCK, JOANIE LOVES BOCCE and WHITE ZIN advance.

GROUP PLAY · RED — Read this one twice. On Wisconsin put up 94 points, the biggest number in the whole tournament. Ohiowa put up 88. BOTH went 4-1 — and Ohiowa got the higher seed anyway. Del Bocce Vista took third at 3-2. OHIOWA, ON WISCONSIN and DEL BOCCE VISTA advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — Five teams, four games each, and Chi'Bocce didn't lose any of them. 4-0, 89 points, the last unbeaten side standing. Dug z World and Mustache Riders squeezed through at 2-2. CHI'BOCCE, DUG Z WORLD and MUSTACHE RIDERS advance.

ROUND ONE — And the bracket bares its teeth immediately. Trash Panda's put out White Zin. Dug z World ended Del Bocce Vista. Joanie handled Loopers. But the headline: MUSTACHE RIDERS, the twelve seed, the very last team in the field, knocked out On Wisconsin and that 94-point group campaign. Gone in one game.

QUARTERFINALS — Chi'Bocce rolled past Trash Panda's. Ohiowa put down Dug z World. John-John ended Joanie's run. And Mustache Riders did it AGAIN — the last seed in the tournament took down Kase-Kare-Cock, a group winner, and walked into the final four.

SEMIFINALS — Chi'Bocce finally stopped the Mustache Riders fairy tale, and the glass slipper came off at the very last step. On the other side, Ohiowa ended John-John's day. The unbeaten met the team that had beaten everybody else.

THE FINAL — Chi'Bocce: 4-0 in the group, 89 points, three straight in the bracket, not one loss all day. Ohiowa: 4-1, a group title won on a tiebreak, and scalps in every round. Six wins each. One of them was about to get a seventh.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: CHI'BOCCE 🏆 — Perfect. Not a single loss from the first hole of group play to the last ball of the final. Four in the group, three in the bracket, seven for seven, and the 2019 trophy never had another name on it. Flawless.
2020: WELCOME TO THE 2020 B.B.G.C. — The covid year. Four groups, four teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · RED — The defending champions arrived and made a statement. Hawkeyes 3-0, 58 points, untouched. The Seekers took second at 2-1, and I Can't Decide slipped in at 1-2 ahead of winless Guns n Rollers. HAWKEYES, THE SEEKERS and I CAN'T DECIDE advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — Muck Fichigan matched them stride for stride: 3-0 and 61 points, the best mark of the day. Vivace do Tinge went 2-1, Spencer Torkelson 1-2. Balz Deep went home without a win. MUCK FICHIGAN, VIVACE DO TINGE and SPENCER TORKELSON advance.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — Nobody could separate. Del Bocce Vista, Trash n Stache and Dickens Cider ALL finished 2-1, and it came down to points: 58, 56, 43. Three teams in, D-Boccery out at 0-3. DEL BOCCE VISTA, TRASH N STACHE and DICKENS CIDER advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Covid Cowboys came through the only group nobody could beat outright, finishing 2-0-1. Vandelay Industries Industries 2-1, Brothers Boor 1-1-1, and The Boys r Back never got going. COVID COWBOYS, VANDELAY INDUSTRIES INDUSTRIES and BROTHERS BOOR advance.

ROUND ONE — Dickens Cider ousted The Seekers. Del Bocce Vista saw off Spencer Torkelson. Vandelay Industries Industries ended I Can't Decide. And Trash n Stache put out Brothers Boor. Four gone, eight left, and the giants were waiting.

QUARTERFINALS — And the giants fell. Muck Fichigan held serve over Dickens Cider, but Del Bocce Vista upset Vivace do Tinge, Trash n Stache ran through the unbeaten Covid Cowboys, and then the big one: VANDELAY INDUSTRIES INDUSTRIES KNOCKED OUT THE HAWKEYES. The defending champions, 3-0 in the group, out in one game.

SEMIFINALS — Muck Fichigan turned back Del Bocce Vista to reach the final unbeaten. And Trash n Stache, who'd already taken down the Covid Cowboys, did it again — ending Vandelay Industries Industries's giant-killing run. Two teams left.

THE FINAL — Muck Fichigan: 3-0, 61 points, group champions, two clean bracket wins, not a blemish anywhere. Trash n Stache: out of the three-way logjam in Yellow, and then the hardest road in the tournament — the undefeated Covid Cowboys AND the team that put out the champions.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: TRASH N STACHE 🏆 — Out of a three-way logjam in Yellow, past the unbeaten Covid Cowboys, past the side that had just knocked out the defending champions, and then past Muck Fichigan — 3-0 in their group and unbeaten all day — with the trophy on the line. And a word for Spencer: the drunkest man ever to win this tournament. The covid year belongs to Trash n Stache.
2021: WELCOME TO THE 2021 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, six teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · RED — White Zin were ruthless: 5-0, the only perfect record in the group, 91 points. And spare a thought for John-John, who went 4-1 and scored MORE than them — 97 points, the biggest total in the tournament — and still finished second. Trash n Stache edged a 2-2-1 tiebreak for third. WHITE ZIN, JOHN-JOHN and TRASH N STACHE advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Muck Fichigan took it at 4-1 with The Big LeBocce right behind at 3-2. Then a dead heat for the last ticket: Joanie Loves Bocce and Don Cuzzi both 2-2-1, and Joanie's 75 points to 64 settled it. MUCK FICHIGAN, THE BIG LEBOCCE and JOANIE LOVES BOCCE advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — The cruellest group on the board. FOUR teams inside one game of each other: Richard Simmons 3-1-1, Smug Champs 3-1-1, Hilltoppers 3-2 — and Del Bocce Vista, also 3-2, with 84 points, MORE than any of them. It wasn't enough. Del Bocce Vista miss out. THE RICHARD SIMMONS EXP., SMUG CHAMPS and HILLTOPPERS advance.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — The Seekers went through it untouched, 5-0 with 87 points. Hot Sauce took second at 3-1-1 and Brothers Boor third at 3-2 — which sent the Hawkeyes home at 2-3. THE SEEKERS, HOT SAUCE and BROTHERS BOOR advance.

ROUND ONE — Brothers Boor ended The Big LeBocce. Smug Champs handled Hilltoppers. Trash n Stache put out Hot Sauce. And JOANIE LOVES BOCCE — the twelve seed, the last team into the field — took down John-John and that 97-point group campaign. The first tremor.

QUARTERFINALS — White Zin brushed aside Brothers Boor, and Muck Fichigan ended Trash n Stache. But look at the seven line: SMUG CHAMPS knocked out The Seekers, 5-0 group champions. And Joanie did it again, putting out the Richard Simmons Exp. The twelve seed was in the final four.

SEMIFINALS — And then the earthquake. JOANIE LOVES BOCCE, the LAST seed in the tournament, took down WHITE ZIN — 5-0 in the group, the number one seed, unbeaten all day. On the other side Smug Champs ended Muck Fichigan. A 7 versus a 12 for the title.

THE FINAL — Joanie Loves Bocce: twelfth and last into the bracket, then John-John, then Richard Simmons, then the unbeaten top seed. Three straight giants. Smug Champs: out of the four-way scrum in Blue, then Hilltoppers, then The Seekers, then Muck Fichigan. Neither one was supposed to be here.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: SMUG CHAMPS 🏆 — Seventh seed. Out of the most brutal group on the board, where a team with more points than them didn't even qualify. Four straight wins including two group champions. And in a final nobody could have drawn up, the Smug Champs took it. 2021 belonged to the underdogs.
2022: WELCOME TO THE 2022 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, six teams per group (five in Orange). Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — Royale w/ Cheese went through it without a scratch: 5-0, the only perfect record in the tournament. The Seekers took second at 4-1 and Mickey the Mitcher edged in at 2-2-1. Banana in the Tailpipe never got off the mark. ROYALE W/ CHEESE, THE SEEKERS and MICKEY THE MITCHER advance.

GROUP PLAY · RED — Smug Champs, the defending champions, looked every bit of it at 4-1. Behind them a genuine traffic jam: Brothers Boor and Brainerd Bergs both 2-2-1, with Laces Out, Guns n Rollers and Top Gun all at 2-3. Fine margins everywhere. SMUG CHAMPS, BROTHERS BOOR and BRAINERD BERGS advance.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — The Hawkeyes did not lose a game: 4-0-1, the only unbeaten card in the group stage. White Zin were right there at 3-1-1. Vandelay Industries Industries took the last ticket. HAWKEYES, WHITE ZIN and VANDELAY INDUSTRIES INDUSTRIES advance.

GROUP PLAY · ORANGE — Five teams, four games each. Muck Fichigan came out on top at 3-1, and then a straight tie for second: The Big LeBocce and Be-Yotch-e, Please, both 2-2. Sparty Devils and Billy G.O.A.T. both 1-2-1. MUCK FICHIGAN, BIG LeBOCCE and BE-YOTCH-E, PLEASE advance.

ROUND ONE — Brainerd Bergs edged out Mickey the Mitcher. The Seekers ended Vandelay Industries Industries. The Big LeBocce upset Brothers Boor. And Be-Yotch-e, Please sent WHITE ZIN home in the first game they played. The eleven seed over the six.

QUARTERFINALS — Hawkeyes held firm over The Big LeBocce, Smug Champs saw off Be-Yotch-e, and Muck Fichigan ended The Seekers. But the shock of the day came at the top of the board: BRAINERD BERGS TOOK DOWN ROYALE W/ CHEESE. Five and oh in the group, number one seed, out in a single game.
SEMIFINALS — Brainerd Bergs weren't done — they ended Muck Fichigan too. And the Hawkeyes stopped the defending champion Smug Champs cold. An eight seed and a two seed for the trophy.

THE FINAL — Hawkeyes: 4-0-1, the group stage's only unbeaten team, 2018 champions chasing a second. Brainerd Bergs: eighth seed out of a logjammed Red group, and a bracket run that had already buried the number one seed and a group champion.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: BRAINERD BERGS 🏆 — They came in eighth. They beat the top seed, they beat a group champion, and then they beat the only team that hadn't lost all day. The Hawkeyes' second title will have to wait. 2022 goes to the Brainerd Bergs.
2023: WELCOME TO THE 2023 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, six teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · ORANGE — The Big LeBocce were the class of it: 4-1 and 99 points, the biggest haul in the tournament. Then a dead heat — Don Cuzzi and Loh Hang Balls both 3-2, Loh Hang with MORE points (84 to 78), and Don Cuzzi took the higher seed on the head-to-head. The Hawkeyes missed out at 2-3. THE BIG LeBOCCE, DON CUZZI and LOH HANG BALLS advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Another photo finish. Holy Rollers and Joanie Loves Bocce both finished 3-2, and again the team with fewer points took the group — Holy Rollers 71, Joanie 84. Hot Sauce came third out of a three-way 2-2-1 pile-up. HOLY ROLLERS, JOANIE LOVES BOCCE and HOT SAUCE advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — White Zin did not lose: 4-0-1, the only unbeaten record in the field. Sister Swap 3-1-1 behind them, and Brothers Boor squeezed through third at 3-2 — which turned out to matter rather a lot. WHITE ZIN, SISTER SWAP and BROTHERS BOOR advance.
GROUP PLAY · RED — Loose Meats took it at 4-1, Ghetto Ballers 3-1-1, The Seekers 3-2. A tight, scrappy group from start to finish. LOOSE MEATS, GHETTO BALLERS and THE SEEKERS advance.

ROUND ONE — Don Cuzzi ended The Seekers. Hot Sauce put out Ghetto Ballers. Loh Hang Balls ousted Joanie Loves Bocce. And Brothers Boor — eleventh seed, third out of their own group — quietly took care of Sister Swap. Nobody was watching them yet.

QUARTERFINALS — And the top seed went down. DON CUZZI KNOCKED OUT WHITE ZIN, 4-0-1 in the group and unbeaten all day, in their very first game of the bracket. Hot Sauce ended Holy Rollers. The Big LeBocce held off Loh Hang Balls. And Brothers Boor took down group champions Loose Meats.

SEMIFINALS — Don Cuzzi kept rolling, ending Hot Sauce. And Brothers Boor struck again — this time burying The Big LeBocce and that tournament-best 99-point campaign. The eleven seed was one win from the trophy.

THE FINAL — Don Cuzzi: second out of Orange on a head-to-head tiebreak, then the unbeaten number one seed, then Hot Sauce. Brothers Boor: ELEVENTH seed, third in their own group, and already the scalps of two group champions.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: BROTHERS BOOR 🏆 — Eleventh seed. Third in their own group. And then they went out and beat Sister Swap, Loose Meats, The Big LeBocce and Don Cuzzi to lift the thing. One of the great runs in B.B.G.C. history. 2023 belongs to Brothers Boor.
2024: WELCOME TO THE 2024 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, six teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · ORANGE — Pure gridlock. FOUR teams finished 3-2 — White Zin, D-Boccery, Brothers Boor and Long Ballz — and the whole group came down to the points column. White Zin's 97 led the way, and Brothers Boor were the ones left out despite matching every record. WHITE ZIN, D-BOCCERY and LONG BALLZ advance.

GROUP PLAY · RED — Joanie Loves Bocce took it at 4-1. Then, naturally, another traffic jam: Hot Sauce, Hawkeyes and Tyson's Micropenis ALL 3-2, sorted on points, 76 to 75 to 64. The M.J.s went home 0-5. JOANIE LOVES BOCCE, HOT SAUCE and HAWKEYES advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — The Seekers were perfect: 5-0. But look behind them — Hide Your Moms went 4-1 and racked up 101 POINTS, the biggest single-group total anywhere in the archive, and still finished second. Laces Out took third. THE SEEKERS, HIDE YOUR MOMS and LACES OUT advance.
GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — Gumby Dammit ran the table, 5-0 with 98 points. Sister Swap chased them home at 4-1, Guns n Rollers third at 3-2. GUMBY DAMMIT, SISTER SWAP and GUNS N ROLLERS advance.
ROUND ONE — Hawkeyes saw off Guns n Rollers. Hide Your Moms and those 101 points ended Laces Out. D-Boccery put out Hot Sauce. And Long Ballz upset Sister Swap. The board was set for the big seeds.

QUARTERFINALS — And one of them didn't survive it. HAWKEYES KNOCKED OUT GUMBY DAMMIT — 5-0 in the group, 98 points, gone in one game. White Zin ended the Hide Your Moms juggernaut. The Seekers put out D-Boccery, and Joanie Loves Bocce ended Long Ballz.
SEMIFINALS — White Zin stopped the Hawkeyes upset train. The Seekers turned back Joanie Loves Bocce. A team that had only gone 3-2 in its group against a team that hadn't lost at all.

THE FINAL — The Seekers: 5-0 in Blue, two clean bracket wins, unbeaten from the first ball to the last. White Zin: third-best record of the four group winners, through a four-way tiebreak just to get out of Orange — and now one win from everything.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: WHITE ZIN 🏆 — They finished 3-2. They needed a points tiebreak to even win their group. And then they beat Hide Your Moms, they beat Hawkeyes, and they beat the unbeaten The Seekers in the final. A first B.B.G.C. title — six years after losing the 2018 final. They'd been waiting.
2025: WELCOME TO THE 2025 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, six teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round. And a defending champion with something to prove.

GROUP PLAY · PINK — White Zin picked up exactly where they left off: 5-0, 97 points, nobody laid a glove on them. Then a straight dead heat for second — Brothers Boor and Holy Rollers both 3-2, 74 points to 75 — and it went to the head-to-head. CooCoo 4 Coconuts finished 0-5. WHITE ZIN, BROTHERS BOOR and HOLY ROLLERS advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Muck Fichigan went through unbeaten at 4-0-1, the only team in the tournament nobody could beat. The Seekers took second at 3-2 and Mag Dick third at 2-2-1 — file that name away. MUCK FICHIGAN, THE SEEKERS and MAG DICK advance.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — Glory Holz took it at 4-1 with 87 points. Guns n Rollers and the Hawkeyes both came home 3-2, split by a single point, 78 to 71. D-Boccery propped up the group at 1-4. GLORY HOLZ, GUNS N ROLLERS and HAWKEYES advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — As tight as it gets at the top: Joanie Loves Bocce AND Smug Champs both 4-1, with Smug Champs scoring more, 88 to 83 — and Joanie taking the group anyway. Sparty Devils third at 2-3. JOANIE LOVES BOCCE, SMUG CHAMPS and SPARTY DEVILS advance.

ROUND ONE — Holy Rollers ended Guns n Rollers in an all-Rollers affair. Smug Champs put out Sparty Devils. Brothers Boor knocked out the Hawkeyes. And MAG DICK — third in their own group — took down the The Seekers. The upsets had started early.

QUARTERFINALS — White Zin brushed past Holy Rollers. Muck Fichigan ended Brothers Boor. Smug Champs knocked out group champions Joanie Loves Bocce. And Mag Dick went and did it AGAIN, putting out Glory Holz, a group winner, to reach the final four from the eleven line.
SEMIFINALS — White Zin ended the Smug Champs' run, and Muck Fichigan finally stopped Mag Dick. The defending champions against the only team nobody had beaten all tournament.

THE FINAL — Muck Fichigan: 4-0-1 in Green, unbeaten across the entire tournament, two bracket wins on the way. White Zin: 5-0 in Pink, 97 points, the defending champions, and a chance to do something nobody in the archive had ever done.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: WHITE ZIN — BACK-TO-BACK 🏆 — Perfect in the group, perfect in the bracket, and in the final they took down the last unbeaten team in the field. Two titles in two years, the first repeat champions in B.B.G.C. history — and from the club that lost the 2018 final and waited six years for the first one. A dynasty, written in red.
2026: WELCOME TO THE 2026 B.B.G.C. — Four groups. Two teams withdrew, so Pink and Red played out as fives. Three from each group advance to the knockout round. And at the top of the draw, White Zin going for three in a row — with the entire field rooting against them.

GROUP PLAY · PINK (SOUTHMOUTH) — White Zin did what White Zin do: 4-0, 74 points, nobody close. The Mesh Strikes Back took second at 3-1. The Big LeBocce scraped into third at 2-2 — remember them. The Hitchhikers went home 0-4. WHITE ZIN, THE MESH and THE BIG LEBOCCE advance.

GROUP PLAY · RED (GLORY HOLE) — Muck Fichigan unbeaten again at 3-0-1, the only side in the tournament nobody could put away, held to a 15-15 tie by Brawley Heat Morkes Meat. Brawley Heat took second at 2-1-1, Laces Out third at 2-2. Holy Rollers and the Hawkeyes both finished 1-3. MUCK FICHIGAN, BRAWLEY HEAT MORKES MEAT and LACES OUT advance.

GROUP PLAY · ORANGE (BLAGGO) — Smug Champs ran the table: 5-0, 87 points, the only perfect record in the field. The High End Jerkoffs took second at 3-2. Then a three-car pile-up at 2-3 — The Busch Men, Balboa's Balls and Joanie Loves Bocce — sorted on the points column, where The Busch Men's +14 settled it. D-Boccery propped up the group at 1-4. SMUG CHAMPS, THE HIGH END JERKOFFS and THE BUSCH MEN advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN (LATRELL) — The deepest group in the tournament. The Bocce Ballers won it 4-1 with 94 points, and behind them THREE teams finished 3-2. Team Daisy took second on 88 points. Guns n Rollers took third on the head-to-head — they had beaten Tight Lines 13-12 in group play, and that single point sent Tight Lines home at 3-2. Full Send Fondlers finished 0-5. THE BOCCE BALLERS, TEAM DAISY and GUNS N ROLLERS advance.

ROUND ONE — Guns n Rollers edged The High End Jerkoffs 14-13. The Busch Men put out The Mesh. Team Daisy saw off Laces Out 15-11. And The Big LeBocce, third in their own group and in from the eleven line, ended Brawley Heat Morkes Meat.

QUARTERFINALS — Smug Champs ended Guns n Rollers 13-7. Muck Fichigan brushed The Busch Men aside 19-6. Team Daisy knocked out the team that had won their own group, beating The Bocce Ballers 18-12. And then the one the whole field had been waiting for: THE BIG LEBOCCE PUT OUT WHITE ZIN. Third in Pink, two places and thirty-nine points behind them all group long — and they ended the three-peat in the quarterfinal.

SPECIAL MENTION · THE BIG LEBOCCE — Brett Koenig and Jay Hackney did not lift the cup in 2026, but they won the hearts of every competitor in the field by making sure White Zin did not pull off the three-peat. In from the eleven line, third in the very group White Zin had just walked through 4-0, and they ended the two-time champions in the quarterfinal before their own run stopped in the semis. No trophy. Plenty of gratitude.

SEMIFINALS — Smug Champs survived Muck Fichigan 14-13, one point between the 2021 champions and the only team nobody had beaten. Team Daisy ended The Big LeBocce's run at 16. The final was set: a former champion against a team playing its first tournament.

THE FINAL — Smug Champs: 5-0 in Orange, 87 points, the 2021 title already on the shelf. Team Daisy: Lou Donzelli and Tim Provost, two men who had been turning up to this thing for years and never once got their hands on the cup — Tim through six seasons with The Seekers, Lou across Don Cuzzi, Top Gun and The Boys r Back. This year they broke up their own teams and threw in together.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: TEAM DAISY 🏆 — 17-15 in the final, and a perfect 4-0 through the bracket from the seven line: Laces Out, their own group winners, The Big LeBocce, and Smug Champs to finish it. Second in their group and champions of the tournament. Lou and Tim came close for years with other people. The year they joined forces, they took the whole thing.
